name: KMM Global Development Basemap
riskNotes: Free public development vector basemap. Availability and style updates are outside KMM control; migrate to self-hosted PMTiles before strict production SLA.
migrationNotes: Replace styleUrl with /maps/styles/kmm-global-self-hosted.json and serve a global PMTiles archive at /maps/vector/kmm-global-basemap.pmtiles with source id kmm-global-basemap.

labelStrategy.futureSwitcher: A future TH / EN / MM switcher can swap provider style language variants or rewrite text-field expressions centrally before passing the style to MapLibre.

name: KMM Global Self-hosted Basemap
riskNotes: Placeholder only. Do not activate until a global PMTiles archive and matching style layers are produced outside this repository.
migrationNotes: Expected source contract: source id kmm-global-basemap, source type vector, URL pmtiles:///maps/vector/kmm-global-basemap.pmtiles, OSM-derived layers for earth/water/boundary/transportation/place/poi.

name: KMM Local Boundary Fallback
attribution: © KMM internal map foundation © OpenStreetMap contributors
riskNotes: Local non-network fallback used when the global basemap provider fails. Shows neutral background plus KMM Myanmar business layers.
migrationNotes: Keep this lightweight fallback even after self-hosted global PMTiles is added.
